name: Calor
summary: In Darkshire, Calor directs the fight against worgen stalking Duskwood. Under Jonathan Carevin, he helps the Carevin family hunt the beasts threatening the forests.

sections.title: A Loyalist in the Shadows
sections.body: In Darkshire, Calor helps the Carevin family fight the horrors closing in on town. He works under Jonathan Carevin, one of Darkshire's defenders. Together they seek to destroy the supernatural threats before the remaining townsfolk are slaughtered.

sections.title: The Worgen Menace
sections.body: Calor sends fighters after the worgen prowling Duskwood, especially near the Rotting Orchard. These wolf-men are more dangerous than common beasts. They slaughter travelers and patrols alike. So Calor calls on capable fighters to thin their ranks and investigate where they came from, hoping to stem their attacks.

faq.answer: Calor lives in Darkshire and supports the Carevin family. He helps defend the town by sending fighters after dangerous threats in Duskwood.
Calor can be found in Darkshire, the Alliance town in the forests of Duskwood.

faq.q: What is Calor's relationship with Jonathan Carevin?
faq.answer: Calor supports the Carevin family and follows Jonathan Carevin's direction in the fight against monsters in the forest.

faq.q: What enemies does Calor have you fight?
faq.answer: Calor sends fighters to hunt worgen in the woods, especially near the Rotting Orchard.

faq.q: Why is the worgen threat so urgent in Duskwood?
faq.answer: The worgen are vicious predators that attack anything on sight. Without regular culls, they could overrun Darkshire's thin defenses. Calor coordinates the effort alongside the Night Watch.

faq.q: Is Calor a member of the Night Watch?
faq.answer: No. Calor grew disillusioned with what he saw as the Night Watch's complacency. He joined Jonathan Carevin and supports the Carevin family's fight against worgen.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can help Calor defend Darkshire's isolated townsfolk in the gloomy woods.
As a hunter, you can work with Calor to track and cull savage beasts that threaten the forest's natural order.
